I added a `vibe()` route decorator to both `FastAPI` and `APIRouter`, and submitted the patch (2 files changed).

The issue gives no spec, and nothing in the repo mentions "vibe", so I guessed: `@app.vibe(path)` registers a path operation under a custom HTTP method `VIBE`, passing other keyword arguments through to `api_route`. A quick check confirmed a `VIBE` request returns 200 and the route appears in the OpenAPI schema. I did not run the test suite, and the hidden tests may expect different behaviour.
